summary: OpenAI released version 0.19.4 of the openai-agents-python SDK containing a batch of bug fixes across guardrails, sessions, tracing, sandbox, and realtime connection handling.

practices.reason: Teams running the agents SDK in production should be aware of behavior changes around session handling, branch IDs, and guardrail result handling that a patch upgrade introduces.
practices.quote: fix(sessions): reject reused branch IDs when creating a branch by @seratch in https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/pull/4186
